scope: Standalone GNU find compatibility adapter and optional private Pi Bash integration

requirements.contract: A narrow directory-root, safe-name/type conjunction listing subset may use fd; every other GNU invocation retains its original argv.
GNU precedence, short circuiting, negation, comma, default printing and action truth values remain native unchanged.
Exact starting-point spelling, root inclusion, hidden/ignored entries, traversal order and repeated/overlapping root multiplicity match GNU.
Newlines, Unicode and invalid UTF-8 names/argv preserve exact raw output and native argv bytes.
Filesystem failures, malformed fd protocol, missing engines and overflow fall back before output while retaining original GNU partial output/diagnostics/status.
Exec/output/deletion actions execute exactly once under GNU, and stdin-root lists are not consumed by fd preflight.
The private non-exported Bash function preserves native bypasses, children and outside shells; optional Pi native bash adaptation is gated dynamically by exact provider.
An actual npm tarball extracts and installs offline; its public entry and helper retain byte/status/scope behavior.
A finite seeded campaign compares actual CLI bytes/status with GNU and records distinct fd/native routes and actual fd executions separately.
Test-only root-output/order/fallback mutations are rejected by semantic GNU oracles; syntax and infrastructure failures receive no mutation credit.
Cancellation and deadlines terminate owned descendants; inherited raw or removed working directories retain GNU behavior.
